description: How do you get to the moon?
summary: The project resulted in a playable slideshow involving five critical decisions a commander has to make during a Lunar outpost mission. There's four elements the commander has to balance, including oxygen, power, radiation shielding and science. The condition that some oxygen was lost during the flight, and occurrence of X-class solar flare was added to avoid safe options as they force unavoidable costs in every decision in the game.
details:
Google slides was used to create the prototype.

To play the game, one must present the slideshow.

The game progresses by clicking on the hyperlink of choice given. Clicking on the hyperlink takes the player to the slide the reflects the decision made.

The intended impact of the project is to create a fun, replay-able and insightful game for 7 to 12 year olds – a one that shows how an astronaut's choice can determine the success of failure of a mission.

The prototype is a decision making game with a total of 28 possible ending. To encourage reruns with a different tactic a replay button was added at the end.

Assuming the player possess no prior knowledge, jargons were avoided.
